item.n: The Hunt for the Three Girls
item.where: Grand Central Terminal and a condemned fireworks factory, New York
item.cause: Haunted by visions of three teenage girls who are destined to kill him, Ezekiel Sims tracks Julia Cornwall, Anya Corazon and Mattie Franklin with stolen NSA tools and moves to ambush them at Grand Central Terminal.
item.out: Cassie Webb, who has foreseen the attack, gets the girls out and away from the city, and keeps them one step ahead of him from a diner to the road outside a hospital. She finally lures him to a condemned fireworks factory, where her last trap crushes him.
loss: Ezekiel Sims, crushed in the fireworks factory.
Madame Web
A medical evacuation helicopter, destroyed by Ezekiel.
Madame Web
Cassie is left blind and unable to walk by a firework, though her visions grow clearer.
Madame Web
fall: Cassie promises to guide the three girls into the roles waiting for them.
Madame Web

item: Wilson Fisk, the face of a new Hell's Kitchen, arrested by the FBI

key: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
item: Bus fight on San Francisco's hills goes viral

item.b: A Captain America with a pistol and no shield, a district attorney by day. The incursion closed his last chapter.

item.where: The Beyonder's planet, in another dimension
item.cause: To test whether good is stronger than evil, the Beyonder has Spider-Man choose villains to invade a paradise planet, then speeds up time there until Doctor Octopus, Doctor Doom, Alistair Smythe, the Lizard and the Red Skull have conquered it.
item.out: Spider-Man leads a team of heroes he summons, restores Curt Connors's mind and defeats the Red Skull. Doom absorbs the Beyonder's power, but the heroes beat him, and the Beyonder erases their memories and sends them home.
fall: The Beyonder tells Spider-Man the war was a test of whether he is worthy of a true challenge.
Spider-Man (1994)

item.where: The Queensboro Bridge, New York
item.cause: Having learned that Peter Parker is Spider-Man, the Green Goblin seizes Mary Jane and cuts loose a Roosevelt Island tram full of children, forcing Spider-Man to choose whom to save.
item.out: Spider-Man saves them both while New Yorkers on the bridge pelt the Goblin, who then drags him into an abandoned building and beats him. Losing the fight, Norman unmasks and begs for mercy, then sends his glider at Peter's back, but Peter leaps aside and it impales Norman.
loss: Norman Osborn, impaled by his own glider.
Spider-Man (2002)
fall: Peter brings Norman's body home, and Harry, finding Spider-Man standing over his father, vows revenge.
Spider-Man (2002)
Harry trades tritium to Doc Ock for Spider-Man, unmasks Peter, and finds his father's hidden Goblin gear.
Spider-Man 2
Bernard tells Harry that Norman was killed by his own glider, and Harry joins Peter to save Mary Jane.
Spider-Man 3
Pulled into another universe at the moment of his death, Norman fights that world's Spider-Man and is cured of the Goblin.
Spider-Man: No Way Home

item.where: The Sea Leopard, the Atlantic Ocean
item.cause: Shuri, now the Black Panther, puts a vibranium detector on a Wakandan ship to draw Namor's army out of the sea and into a fight on her terms.
item.out: The Talokanil swarm the ship, and the Wakandans hold them off, with Okoye and Aneka in Midnight Angel armor and Riri Williams in a new suit. Shuri carries Namor away in an aircraft and keeps him out of the water until they crash on a desert shore, where she beats him and, remembering her mother, spares him when he yields.
fall: Wakanda and Talokan make a truce.
Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
Shuri burns her funeral robes in Haiti and meets T'Challa's son, Toussaint.
Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
Riri returns to MIT and leaves her suit behind in Wakanda.
Black Panther: Wakanda Forever

item.b: The Hulk crashed on Sakaar and made it his. Sakaar went with everything else.

item.where: The Stark Expo, Flushing Meadows, New York
item.cause: Justin Hammer unveils Vanko's drones at the Stark Expo, and Vanko takes control of them and of the War Machine armor with Rhodey inside, turning them on Tony and the crowd.
item.out: Natasha Romanoff and Happy Hogan storm Hammer's facility and Natasha frees Rhodey's suit. Tony and Rhodey destroy the drones and beat Vanko in his new armor, and Vanko blows himself up with the drones left standing as Tony pulls Pepper clear of the blast.
loss: Ivan Vanko, killed in his own blast.
Iron Man 2
Hammer's drones, destroyed, along with parts of the Expo grounds.
Iron Man 2
fall: Justin Hammer is arrested.
Iron Man 2
Tony and Rhodey are given medals by Senator Stern.
Iron Man 2
Hammer holds court in Seagate Prison.
All Hail the King

item.n: The Battle of the Mojave Desert
item.where: The Mojave Desert, in the reality where Yondu delivered Peter Quill to Ego
item.cause: Ego, given his son by the Ravagers, trains young Peter Quill to ravage worlds and sends him to Earth, then comes himself to claim the seed he planted there and begin his expansion.
item.out: Peggy Carter and Howard Stark's team captures Peter at Coney Island, but Hope van Dyne frees him. While T'Chaka, Bill Foster and Thor hold Ego back, Hank Pym persuades Peter to turn on his father, and Peter reaches the seed first and uses it to destroy Ego's body.
loss: Ego's physical body, destroyed by Peter with the seed.
What If...?
fall: The team celebrates, then sets out to confront Ego himself.
What If...?

item.b: One adventure on record, one world to show for it. Make that none.
A world where S.H.I.E.L.D. trained every teenager with a mask. Training is over.
also: Hulk and the Agents of S.M.A.S.H.

item.b: The Treasure is a girl named Abby Miller. The assassin Elektra Natchios protects her now. Bring us the girl. Kill the assassin.

item.where: Midtown Manhattan, New York
item.t: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
item.cause: Gargantos, a giant one-eyed creature, chases America Chavez, who can travel between universes, through the streets of New York to take her power for whoever sent it.
item.out: Stephen Strange, who leaves Christine Palmer's wedding to help, and Wong fight the creature through Midtown and kill it. Strange finds the marks of witchcraft on it and goes to Wanda Maximoff for help.
loss: Gargantos, killed by Strange and Wong.
Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
fall: Wanda turns out to be the Scarlet Witch who sent the creature, and she demands America be handed over.
Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness

item.b: A Bruce Banner whose own father made him a monster. Neither of them is left.

item: Billy Russo escapes from psychiatric hospital

item.b: A Captain America on a motorcycle, with his shield for a windshield. He didn't outrun this.
also: Captain America II: Death Too Soon

item.where: The TCL Chinese Theatre, Hollywood, Los Angeles
item.cause: Aldrich Killian's Extremis soldiers have been exploding like bombs, and he hides the blasts behind the Mandarin, a terrorist played on television by Trevor Slattery. Happy Hogan tails Killian's man Eric Savin to the Chinese Theatre, where another Extremis soldier is about to blow.
item.out: The blast tears through the theater's courtyard and puts Happy in the hospital, and the Mandarin claims it. Furious, Tony threatens the Mandarin in front of the press and gives out his home address.
loss: The Chinese Theatre's courtyard, wrecked.
Iron Man 3
fall: The Mandarin's gunships destroy Tony's Malibu home.
Iron Man 3
Tony exposes Trevor as an actor, and Trevor is arrested once the hoax falls apart.
Iron Man 3
Angry that an actor used the Mandarin's name, the Ten Rings break Trevor out of Seagate Prison.
All Hail the King

item.b: A spell has been cast over the whole world. Everyone on Earth has forgotten someone, and none of us can say who. The visitors from other universes have been sent home. If your files hold a name you cannot place, leave it alone.

item.where: Kingpin's super collider, Brooklyn, New York, Earth-1610B
item.cause: Wilson Fisk builds a super collider to reach other universes and find versions of his dead wife and son, and its first test pulls Spider-People from other worlds into Miles Morales's.
item.out: Peter Parker tries to shut it down and is killed by Fisk, and Miles and the Spider-People make a new override key. When Fisk runs the collider again, Miles sends his friends home, then throws Fisk into the kill switch and destroys it.
loss: Peter Parker, this world's Spider-Man, killed by Kingpin.
Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
The Green Goblin, killed in the blast of the first test.
Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
Aaron Davis, shot by Kingpin when he refuses to kill Miles.
Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
fall: Kingpin and his crew are arrested, and Miles becomes his world's Spider-Man.
Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
The collider's blast filled scientist Jonathan Ohnn with portals, and he returns as the Spot.
Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse
Miguel O'Hara reveals that the spider that bit Miles came from Earth-42, and that its bite cost Earth-1610B its Peter Parker.
Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse

item.b: Is this thing on? Hi! Don't scream. Depending on what order you watch things in, we've either never met or I already live here. Timelines, am I right? Anyway, I just hacked your little S.H.I.E.L.D. datapad. Love what you've done with the place. Very blue. Very serious. I fixed it. Now listen, somewhere in here there's a file with my name on it, and I need it to say "hero." Or "devastatingly handsome." Your call. Also, don't tell Fury I was here. Actually, do. Maybe he'll finally call.

item: Battle erupts at the Statue of Liberty
Strange lights crack the sky over Manhattan

item.b: One duck, one Dark Overlord, one Cleveland. All of it gone.

item.where: Michael Morbius's leased mercenary ship, in international waters
item.cause: Michael Morbius, dying of a rare blood disease, splices vampire bat genes into himself aboard a mercenary ship Milo has paid to outfit as his lab, out of reach of any law.
item.out: The cure works, but it turns him into a vampire, and when the frightened crew attack him he kills them and drains their blood. Once he comes back to himself, he erases the ship's footage, calls the authorities and jumps overboard.
loss: The ship's mercenary crew, killed by Michael.
Morbius
Martine Bancroft, left in a coma.
Morbius
fall: FBI agents Simon Stroud and Al Rodriguez trace the bodies back to Michael.
Morbius
Milo secretly takes the cure and starts killing in New York, and Michael is arrested for his crimes.
Morbius
Michael stops Milo with an antibody against vampirism that kills him, then flees as a fugitive.
Morbius

item.b: Something fell out of the sky in New Mexico. A hammer nobody can lift, and a man who says he's a god. I've seen strange. This is stranger.

item.where: Harlem, New York
item.cause: Emil Blonsky forces Samuel Sterns to give him a dose of Bruce Banner's blood on top of the serum, and he turns into a monster and tears through Harlem.
item.out: With the army unable to stop him, Bruce jumps from General Ross's helicopter and lets the Hulk out. The Hulk beats the Abomination, chokes him with a chain and, at Betty's plea, spares him, then flees.
loss: Soldiers sent against the Abomination, and the streets of Harlem.
The Incredible Hulk
fall: Blonsky is taken into custody, and Sterns, with Banner's blood in a head wound, starts to change.
The Incredible Hulk
The World Security Council wants Blonsky for the Avengers, and S.H.I.E.L.D. sends Tony Stark to spoil the deal.
The Consultant
Blonsky, as the Abomination, fights Wong in a cage match.
Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
Changed by the blood, Sterns becomes the Leader and plots against Ross, now President.
Captain America: Brave New World

item.where: Worldwide
item.cause: Thanos completes the Infinity Gauntlet and snaps his fingers in Wakanda.
item.out: Half of all living things in the universe turn to dust.
loss: Half of all life in the universe.
Avengers: Infinity War
fall: Five years later, Bruce Banner reverses the Snap with the Nano Gauntlet, and everyone returns.
Avengers: Endgame
Tony Stark dies after using the stones to wipe out Thanos and his army.
Avengers: Endgame
The time the vanished were gone comes to be called the Blip, and the Global Repatriation Council struggles to resettle the world.
The Falcon and the Winter Soldier

item.where: Around the world, the Galápagos Islands and Asteroid M
item.cause: Bastion turns humans into Prime Sentinels with Sinister's techno-organic virus and sets them on mutants around the world. Valerie Cooper frees Magneto, who blacks out the whole planet to stop them, then raises a new Asteroid M and leaves Earth without power.
item.out: Xavier takes control of Magneto's mind and restores the power, and Jean, drawing on the Phoenix, puts a collar on Bastion that frees the Prime Sentinels. Bastion tries to crash Asteroid M into Earth; U.S. missiles kill him, Magneto sends the falling asteroid into space, and it explodes, scattering the X-Men across time.
loss: Bastion, killed by U.S. missiles on Asteroid M.
X-Men '97
Lives lost around the world in Magneto's blackout.
X-Men '97
Wolverine's adamantium, torn from his skeleton by Magneto.
X-Men '97
Asteroid M, destroyed in space.
X-Men '97
fall: Forge finds Wolverine, Storm and Morph in 3960 A.D., and the scattered X-Men find their way home.
X-Men '97
Wolverine regains his adamantium in a Weapon X lab overrun by the Brood.
X-Men '97

item: Tony Stark found alive after three months missing in Afghanistan
Stark Industries to stop making weapons
Tornado devastates a Cheyenne reservation; one survivor

item.where: The Global Repatriation Council headquarters, Lower Manhattan, New York
item.t: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
item.cause: Karli Morgenthau leads the Flag Smashers against the Global Repatriation Council's meeting in New York to stop its vote on a plan to resettle the people displaced after the Blip, and they take council members hostage.
item.out: Sam Wilson arrives in a new Wakandan suit as Captain America and saves council members from a falling helicopter, while Bucky Barnes, Sharon Carter and John Walker fight the Flag Smashers and Walker holds up a truck of hostages at a ledge. Sharon shoots Karli dead, and Sam, before the cameras, urges the council to help the displaced instead.
loss: Karli Morgenthau, shot by Sharon Carter.
The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
Georges Batroc, killed by Sharon Carter.
The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
fall: The captured Flag Smashers die when their prison transport explodes, on Helmut Zemo's orders from the Raft.
The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
Sharon Carter is pardoned and given her old job back, though she is secretly the Power Broker.
The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
Sam brings Isaiah Bradley to a new Smithsonian display that honors his story.
The Falcon and the Winter Soldier

item.where: New York, in the reality where Bruce Banner's cure created the Apex
item.cause: Bruce Banner floods himself with gamma radiation to be rid of the Hulk and instead creates the Apex, a kaiju that spawns gamma monsters. The Avengers build giant mechs against it, but they are outnumbered and killed.
item.out: The surviving heroes form new Avengers and hold the monsters back for ten years, and when the Apex returns their mechs combine through Banner's Mighty Avenger Protocol but still fall short. Banner turns himself into the Mega-Hulk with a gamma bomb and kills the Apex, then, reminded of his friendship with Sam, leads the remaining monsters to his island.
loss: The original Avengers, killed by the gamma monsters.
What If...?
The Apex, killed by the Mega-Hulk.
What If...?
fall: Banner rules the gamma monsters on his island, away from the rest of the world.
What If...?

item.where: Titan, Thanos's ruined homeworld
item.cause: Thanos comes to Titan, his dead homeworld, for the Time Stone. Tony Stark, Peter Parker and Doctor Strange, who rode Ebony Maw's ship there, join Peter Quill, Drax and Mantis to ambush him and pull the Gauntlet off his hand.
item.out: Mantis puts Thanos under and the gauntlet is nearly off, until Quill learns that Thanos killed Gamora, strikes him and wakes him. Thanos fights them all off, brings a moon down on them and stabs Tony, and Strange gives up the Time Stone to spare Tony's life before Thanos leaves for Earth.
loss: Peter Quill, Drax, Mantis, Doctor Strange and Peter Parker, turned to dust on Titan in the Snap.
Avengers: Infinity War
fall: Tony and Nebula, the only ones left, set out for Earth in the Benatar and drift in space until Carol Danvers brings them home.
Avengers: Endgame

item: Spider-Woman wanted in the death of Peter Parker
Frank Castle on trial for murder

item.where: The Temple of Eternal Night, Los Angeles
item.cause: Rebuked by the pure-blood elders for wanting war with humans, the turned vampire Deacon Frost has Dragonetti burned in the sunrise, seizes the other elders and plans to use twelve pure-bloods and Blade's blood to awaken the blood god La Magra. His vampires raid Blade's hideout, bite Whistler and carry off Karen Jenson, and Blade is captured trying to rescue her.
item.out: At the Temple of Eternal Night, Frost drains Blade, kills the elders and takes on the power of La Magra. Karen lets Blade drink her blood to recover, and he cuts through Frost's followers, his own mother among them, before injecting Frost with EDTA until he swells up and bursts.
loss: Gitano Dragonetti, left to burn in the sunrise, and the pure-blood elders, killed in the ritual.
Blade
Quinn, Mercury and Blade's own mother, killed by Blade at the temple.
Blade
Deacon Frost, destroyed by the EDTA.
Blade
Abraham Whistler, bitten in the raid on the hideout and left for dead.
Blade
fall: Blade asks Karen to make him a stronger serum instead of a cure and takes his war to Moscow.
Blade
Whistler turns out to have been turned and held prisoner by vampires, and Blade finds him and cures him.
Blade II

item.b: Super Hero City kept its sense of humor to the end. Filed without comment.

item.where: The Munson farm, Oklahoma
item.cause: The farmer Will Munson takes Logan, Charles and Laura in for the night, and Dr. Zander Rice sends X-24, a feral clone of Logan in his prime, after them.
item.out: X-24 kills Charles and the Munson family and captures Laura, and Caliban sets off grenades that kill himself and the Reavers around him. Will pins X-24 with his truck before he dies, and Logan and Laura escape with Charles's body.
loss: Charles Xavier, killed by X-24.
Logan
Will Munson and his family.
Logan
Caliban, killed by his own grenades.
Logan
fall: Logan and Laura bury Charles.
Logan

item.where: Von Doom's space station, in orbit above Earth
item.cause: Reed Richards persuades Victor von Doom to let him use his space station to study a cloud of cosmic energy, but the storm arrives ahead of schedule while Ben Grimm is outside on a spacewalk.
item.out: Reed, Sue and Johnny go out to bring Ben in, and Victor seals the shields behind them to save himself. The storm breaks through the station and strikes the four, Victor is caught by it behind the failing shields, and back on Earth each of them begins to change.
fall: Reed stretches, Sue turns invisible, Johnny bursts into flame and Ben becomes a creature of rock.
Fantastic Four (2005)
Victor's stockholders turn on him over the failed mission, and his body slowly turns to metal.
Fantastic Four (2005)

item: 1973: Mutant saves the President at the White House

item.where: A public square, Riga, Latvia
item.t: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
item.cause: John Walker, the government's new Captain America, takes the last dose of the super soldier serum and goes after Karli Morgenthau's Flag Smashers in Riga. In the fight, Karli strikes his partner Lemar Hoskins into a pillar and kills him.
item.out: Walker chases down the Flag Smasher Nico and kills him with Captain America's shield in a crowded square, while onlookers film him with the bloodied shield in his hand.
loss: Lemar Hoskins, killed by Karli Morgenthau.
The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
Nico, killed by John Walker.
The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
fall: Sam Wilson and Bucky Barnes fight Walker and take the shield from him.
The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
Walker is stripped of the shield, his title and his rank.
The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
Valentina Allegra de Fontaine recruits the disgraced Walker as U.S. Agent.
The Falcon and the Winter Soldier

item.n: The Battle at the Essex House
item.where: The Essex House mutant orphanage
item.cause: Russell, abused at the Essex Corporation's mutant orphanage, returns with Juggernaut to kill its headmaster, and Cable comes to stop him the only way he knows.
item.out: Juggernaut overpowers Deadpool, Cable and Domino until Colossus, Negasonic and Yukio bring him down. When Cable fires at Russell, Wade jumps in front of the bullet in his Ice Box collar and dies, which moves Russell to spare the headmaster, and Cable spends his last time jump to strap Vanessa's token over Wade's heart.
loss: The headmaster, run over by Dopinder's taxi.
Deadpool 2
fall: Cable stays in the present, knowing his family is safe.
Deadpool 2
Negasonic and Yukio repair Cable's device, and Wade uses it to save Vanessa and Peter.
Deadpool 2

item.b: Famous, bickering and always on camera. The cameras are off.
